v1_comparator_audit.audit_basis: pre-outcome candidate-frame row counts plus v1 GRTS error counts
v1_comparator_audit.finding: fixed n_over=3 caused the entire grts call to fail whenever candidate_frame_rows < n_base + 3, including folds where a valid primary base sample could still be drawn
v1_comparator_audit.mixed_exact_match: all five v1 mixed error-bearing pairs had grts_error_draws exactly equal to 50 times the number of folds with candidate_frame_rows < n_base + 3
v1_comparator_audit.correction_direction: strictly strengthens the comparator by allowing the primary base sample to be generated when fewer than three diagnostic replacement sites remain

official_grts.candidate_frame: identical eligible ACSP candidate rows for each stored development fold after known-location filtering and finite-coordinate filtering
official_grts.missing_local_evidence: retain candidate row; map non-finite local evidence to zero before positive auxiliary transform
official_grts.replacement_sites_role: diagnostic oversample only; lack of replacement capacity must not invalidate an otherwise valid primary base design
official_grts.draw_failure_rule: a draw without a verified primary base design after applying the feasible replacement rule contributes zero recovery; warnings and errors are retained and no distance threshold is relaxed
official_grts.empty_candidate_frame_rule: zero recovery with an explicit empty-candidate error artifact
official_grts.outcome_separation: all 50 GRTS base-site sets are written before held-out recovery is scored

estimand.fold_rescue_recovery: recovery of the already-frozen rescue selected IDs from the 72-pair development artifact
estimand.fold_grts_recovery: mean held-out recovery across 50 corrected official GRTS draws

inference.gate: all 72 pairs retained AND mean difference >= 0.015 AND pair-bootstrap 95% CI lower bound > 0 AND sign-flip p < 0.05

next_if_pass.action: refit the unchanged rescue estimator on all 72 development pairs, freeze model/training hashes, then sample a fresh confirmation cohort
next_if_pass.confirmation_primary_comparator: same corrected official GRTS 5.6.1 proportional-local mindis10km contract with feasible diagnostic replacements
